Exercise library

Sixteen exercises, and how each one is graded.

Everything here comes from the trainer's own code: what it measures, the mistakes it flags and the words it says for each, and the skills a set can unlock.

SquatPush-upPlankLungeJumping JackPike push-upSide plankHollow holdMountain climberDead hangBulgarian split squatPistol squatDipsAustralian rowNegative pull-upPull-up

Squat

Side-on · Reps

Stand tall, side-on, to start.

Scored on
Depth, Posture
A good rep
  • Stand side-on with your whole body in frame
  • Sit back until your thighs reach parallel
  • Keep your chest up: lean under about 30°
It flags
  • Depth Go lower, sink the hips to parallel.
  • Chest up You're folding forward, lift your chest.
  • Knees back Knees are drifting past your toes, push the hips back.
  • Control Control the bottom, no bouncing.
  • Slow down Slow it down, two seconds on the way down.
  • Stand tall Finish tall at the top, squeeze the glutes.
Unlocks
  • Bodyweight squat Legs path: 10 squats in one set, average 80+
  • Full-depth squat Legs path: 15 squats in one set, average 90+
  • 20 deep squats Legs path: 20 squats in one set, average 92+

Push-up

Side-on · Reps

Get into the top of a push-up, side-on.

Scored on
Depth, Body line
A good rep
  • Side-on, camera at floor height
  • Lower until your elbows reach about 90°
  • Shoulders, hips and ankles in one line
It flags
  • Depth Lower your chest, elbows to ninety.
  • Hips up Hips are sagging, squeeze your glutes.
  • Hips down Hips are too high, flatten out.
  • Head neutral Keep the head neutral, eyes just ahead of your hands.
  • Slow down Slow the reps down, control both directions.
Unlocks
  • Push-up Push path: 10 push-ups in one set, average 80+
  • Clean push-ups Push path: 15 push-ups in one set, average 90+
  • 20 push-ups Push path: 20 push-ups in one set, average 90+
Train push-up

Plank

Side-on · Hold

Get into your plank, side-on to the camera.

Scored on
Body line
A good hold
  • Side-on, camera at floor height
  • Hands or forearms under your shoulders
  • Hips level: no sag, no pike
It flags
  • Hips up Hips are sagging, squeeze the glutes and lift them.
  • Hips down Hips are too high, lower into one straight line.
  • Head neutral Relax the neck, look at the floor just ahead.
  • Hold steady You're drifting, reset the position and hold.
Unlocks
  • Plank Core path: hold 30 s, average 80+
  • Solid plank Core path: hold 60 s, average 90+
  • Two-minute plank Core path: hold 120 s, average 90+
Train plank

Lunge

Side-on · Reps

Stand tall, side-on, to start.

Scored on
Depth, Posture
A good rep
  • Side-on, then step forward
  • Drop until your front knee is about 90°
  • Keep your torso tall
It flags
  • Depth Bend the front knee more, aim for ninety degrees.
  • Torso tall Stay upright, don't lean over the front leg.
  • Knee back Front knee is past the toes, lengthen your stance.
  • Ease up That's very deep. Ease up a little if the knee complains.
Unlocks
  • Lunge Legs path: 10 lunges in one set, average 85+
  • Clean lunges Legs path: 16 lunges in one set, average 92+
Train lunge

Jumping Jack

Front-on · Reps

Face the camera, arms by your sides.

Scored on
Arms, Feet
A good rep
  • Face the camera
  • Hands all the way overhead
  • Feet out wider than your shoulders
It flags
  • Full range Get the hands all the way overhead.
  • Feet wider Jump the feet out wider.
Unlocks
  • Jumping jacks Conditioning path: 30 jumping jacks in one set, average 85+
  • Clean jacks Conditioning path: 60 jumping jacks in one set, average 92+

Pike push-up

Side-on · Reps

Hands and feet on the floor, hips high, side-on.

Scored on
Depth, Hips high
A good rep
  • Side-on, camera at floor height
  • Hips high: an upside-down V
  • Lower your head toward the floor, elbows past 90°
It flags
  • Depth Lower your head toward the floor, between your hands.
  • Hips high Hips higher, make an upside-down V.
  • Slow down Slow down, lower your head with control.
Unlocks
  • Pike push-up Push path: 8 pike push-ups in one set, average 85+

Side plank

Side-on · Hold

Side plank on one forearm, chest to the camera.

Scored on
Body line
A good hold
  • Chest to the camera, camera at floor height
  • Elbow under the shoulder
  • Hips up: shoulders, hips and ankles in one line
It flags
  • Hips up Your hips are sinking, lift them off the floor.
  • Hips down Hips are too high, lower them into a straight line.
  • Hold steady Stay still, stack your feet and hold.
Unlocks
  • Side plank Core path: hold 30 s, hips up in line, average 80+ (do both sides)
Train side plank

Hollow hold

Side-on · Hold

Lie on your back, side-on, then lift your shoulders and legs.

Scored on
Body shape
A good hold
  • Side-on, camera at floor height
  • Lower back pressed to the floor
  • Shoulders and legs just off the floor
It flags
  • Lift higher Lift your shoulders and legs a little higher.
  • Stretch out Lower your legs a little, stretch out long.
  • Hold still Stay still, press your lower back into the floor.
Unlocks
  • Hollow hold Core path: hold 30 s, shoulders and legs up, average 80+
Train hollow hold

Mountain climber

Side-on · Reps

High plank, side-on, then drive the near knee to your chest.

Scored on
Knee drive, Body line
A good rep
  • Side-on, camera at floor height
  • Hands under the shoulders, hips level
  • Drive the near knee all the way to the chest
It flags
  • Hips up Hips are sagging, brace your core.
  • Knee higher Drive the knee higher, right up to your chest.
  • Hips down Hips are popping up, keep them low.
Unlocks
  • Mountain climbers Conditioning path: 20 knee drives in one set, hips level, average 85+
Train mountain climber

Dead hang

Front-on · Hold

Hang from a bar, facing the camera, arms straight.

Scored on
Straight arms
A good hold
  • Face the camera, whole body and hands in frame
  • Arms straight, shoulders pulled down
  • Still: no swinging
It flags
  • Straight arms Straighten your arms all the way and hang.
  • Hold still You're swinging. Squeeze your legs together and settle.
Unlocks
  • Dead hang Pull path: hang from a bar for 30 s, arms straight, average 80+

Bulgarian split squat

Side-on · Reps

Side-on, front foot forward, back foot up on a bench.

Scored on
Depth, Posture
A good rep
  • Side-on, back foot up on a bench behind you
  • Lower until your front knee is about 90°
  • Torso tall over the front leg
It flags
  • Depth Sink lower, front knee to ninety.
  • Chest up Chest up, stay tall over the front leg.
Unlocks
  • Bulgarian split squat Legs path: 8 in one set, back foot on a bench, average 85+
Train bulgarian split squat

Pistol squat

Side-on · Reps

Side-on, stand on the leg nearer the camera.

Scored on
Depth, Free leg up
A good rep
  • Side-on, standing on the leg nearer the camera
  • Sit down until your hip is below your knee
  • Keep the other leg straight out, off the floor
It flags
  • Depth Sit lower, hip below the knee.
  • Leg up Keep the free leg off the floor.
Unlocks
  • Pistol squat Legs path: 2 in one set, the other leg off the floor, average 85+

Dips

On the bars, side-on, arms straight.

Scored on
Depth
A good rep
  • Side-on to the camera, on parallel bars
  • Lower until your elbows reach about 90°
  • Press back up to straight arms
It flags
  • Depth Lower until your elbows reach ninety.
  • Slow down Slow the dip down, control the bottom.

  • Dips Push path: 5 dips on parallel bars in one set, average 80+

Australian row

Side-on · Reps

Side-on, lie under a low bar, heels on the floor, arms straight.

Scored on
Pull, Body line
A good rep
  • Side-on, under a bar at about waist height
  • Pull until your chest reaches the bar
  • Shoulders, hips and ankles in one line
It flags
  • Chest to bar Pull your chest all the way to the bar.
  • Hips up Hips are sagging, keep your body straight.
Unlocks
  • Australian row Pull path: 10 rows under a low bar in one set, body in one line, average 80+

Negative pull-up

Front-on · Reps

Face the camera, start at the top with your chin over the bar.

Scored on
Slow lowering, Chin over the bar
A good rep
  • Face the camera, the bar and your hands in frame
  • Start at the top, chin over the bar
  • Lower for 3 seconds or more to a dead hang
It flags
  • Slow down Slower. Take three seconds to lower.
  • Start at the top Start each one with your chin over the bar.
Unlocks
  • Negative pull-up Pull path: 5 slow lowers in one set, 3 s each, average 80+
Train negative pull-up

Pull-up

Front-on · Reps

Face the camera, hang from the bar with straight arms.

Scored on
Chin over the bar, Arms bent
A good rep
  • Face the camera, the bar and your hands in frame
  • Start from a dead hang, arms straight
  • Pull until your chin clears the bar
It flags
  • Chin over Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Unlocks
  • Pull-up Pull path: 1 pull-up from a dead hang, chin over the bar, average 80+
  • 10 pull-ups Pull path: 10 pull-ups in one set, chin over the bar, average 85+
